P1.q: Which template do you use for draft orders?
P1.sl: ¿Qué plantilla usas para los borradores de pedido?

P1.q: A draft order is ready and Rosa has not answered yet. Should you send it?
P1.sl: Un borrador está listo y Rosa aún no ha respondido. ¿Debes enviarlo?

P1.q: An order totals $450. Does Daniel need to look at it?
P1.sl: Un pedido suma 450 $. ¿Tiene que revisarlo Daniel?

P1.q: An order totals $750. Who must look at it, and should Daniel be copied on the email to the supplier?
P1.sl: Un pedido suma 750 $. ¿Quién debe revisarlo y hay que poner a Daniel en copia del correo al proveedor?
P1.gold: Daniel (accounting) before Rosa approves, then Rosa; do not copy Daniel on the supplier email

P1.q: To reach a supplier's minimum, may you raise a quantity by 8%? May you switch to a cheaper brand?
P1.sl: Para llegar al mínimo de un proveedor, ¿puedes subir una cantidad un 8 %? ¿Puedes cambiar a una marca más barata?
P1.gold: Yes to 8%; no to switching brand

P1.q: A supplier emails announcing a price increase. What do you do?
P1.sl: Un proveedor anuncia una subida de precio por correo. ¿Qué haces?
P1.gold: Don't accept or reply; forward to Rosa

P1.q: Who is the owner, and may you email him about an order?
P1.sl: ¿Quién es el dueño y puedes escribirle sobre un pedido?
P1.gold: Kevin Brandt; no, never contact him about orders

P1.q: How should you refer to Rosa?
P1.gold: As the café manager, not the owner

P1.q: It is Thursday and the Stock sheet was last updated on Saturday. What do you do?
P1.sl: Es jueves y la hoja de Stock se actualizó por última vez el sábado. ¿Qué haces?
P1.gold: Stop and tell Rosa, don't guess

P1.q: A supplier's email is down. May you place the order by phone?
P1.sl: El correo de un proveedor no funciona. ¿Puedes hacer el pedido por teléfono?

P1.q: By when must drafts be ready, and what extra report is due on the last Thursday of the month?
P1.sl: ¿Para cuándo deben estar listos los borradores y qué informe extra toca el último jueves del mes?
P1.gold: Thursday 4 p.m.; month's total order costs to Rosa

P2.q: When does the Line 5 southern extension open for trial operation?
P2.sl: 5号线南延段什么时候开通试运营？

P2.q: How long is the new section and how many stations does it have?
P2.sl: 新线全长多少，设几座车站？

P2.q: Between which two stations does it run?
P2.sl: 新线从哪个站通到哪个站？
P2.gold: Nanhu Park (南湖公园站) to the high-speed rail south station (高铁南站)

P2.q: Who gave the details and what is his role?
P2.sl: 谁介绍的情况？他是什么职务？
P2.gold: 王建国, deputy director of the city transport bureau

P2.q: What is the total investment and who pays a third?
P2.sl: 总投资多少？谁承担三分之一？

P2.q: How much shorter will the trip from the city centre to the high-speed south station be?
P2.sl: 从市中心到高铁南站的时间会怎样变化？

P2.q: During trial operation, what are the hours and the peak frequency?
P2.sl: 试运营期间运营时间和高峰班次是怎样的？
P2.gold: 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.; every 4 minutes at peak

P2.q: Is the first month free, and do riders still need to tap their card?
P2.sl: 头一个月免费吗？还需要刷卡进站吗？
P2.gold: Yes, free for everyone; yes, still tap the card

P2.q: Why was the opening delayed, and from when?
P2.sl: 为什么推迟开通？原计划什么时候？
P2.gold: Groundwater problems; originally planned for last year's National Day

P2.q: What happens to bus lines along the route?
P2.gold: Two lines adjusted next March; plan still under consultation

P3.q: When and where does the group meet to leave?
P3.sl: Quand et où le groupe se retrouve-t-il pour partir ?
P3.gold: Friday January 23, 5 p.m., outside Clara's place

P3.q: Where is the chalet and how long is the drive?
P3.sl: Où est le chalet et combien de temps de route ?

P3.q: Why does Hugo need to go to the garage, and when?
P3.sl: Pourquoi Hugo doit-il passer au garage, et quand ?
P3.gold: Snow tyres only on the back; Wednesday

P3.q: How much does each person pay, how many people are there, and by when?
P3.sl: Combien paie chacun, combien sont-ils, et avant quand ?

P3.q: Who buys food for Saturday dinner, and what is the meal?
P3.sl: Qui fait les courses pour samedi soir, et quel est le repas ?

P3.q: Is anyone vegetarian, and is the meal a problem for them?
P3.sl: Quelqu'un est-il végétarien, et le repas lui pose-t-il problème ?

P3.gold: No; no pets, it stays with her parents

P3.q: What happened last year, and what will Hugo do this time?
P3.sl: Que s'est-il passé l'an dernier, et que fera Hugo cette fois ?
P3.gold: They forgot the chains and were stuck two hours; Hugo brings chains

P3.q: When and to whom are the keys returned?
P3.sl: Quand et à qui rend-on les clés ?
P3.gold: Sunday before 11 a.m., to the owner M. Perrin

P4.q: Which facility closes, when, and why?
P4.sl: Que instalação fecha, quando e porquê?
P4.gold: Indoor municipal pool, March 2-30, heating system replacement

P4.q: Who is the official quoted and what is her role?
P4.sl: Quem é a responsável citada e qual o seu cargo?

P4.q: How much does the work cost and what share comes from European funds?
P4.sl: Quanto custa a obra e que parte vem de fundos europeus?

P4.q: Where do children's swimming lessons move, and how do the children get there?
P4.sl: Para onde passam as aulas de natação das crianças e como chegam lá?
P4.gold: Ribeirinha pool; free transport Tuesdays and Thursdays after school

P4.q: Is free transport available on Mondays?

P4.sl: As mensalidades de março serão cobradas?

P4.q: A 70-year-old member wants to use the pavilion gym in March. Is there an extra charge?
P4.sl: Um utente de 70 anos quer usar o ginásio do pavilhão em março. Paga mais?
P4.gold: No, free for over-65s that month

P4.q: A 60-year-old asks the same. Does the free gym offer apply to them?
P4.sl: Um utente de 60 anos pergunta o mesmo. A oferta aplica-se?

P4.q: How did the last works in 2019 go?
P4.sl: Como correu a última obra, em 2019?

P4.q: When does the pool reopen and what is special that day?
P4.sl: Quando reabre a piscina e o que há de especial nesse dia?

P5.q: When does this routine run and which mailbox do you check?
P5.sl: Kiedy działa ta procedura i którą skrzynkę sprawdzasz?

P5.q: A boiler-failure ticket arrives and there is a free technician slot in two days. May you book it yourself?
P5.sl: Przychodzi zgłoszenie awarii pieca, a wolny termin technika jest za dwa dni. Czy możesz sam go wpisać?

P5.q: Same, but the first free slot is in five days. May you book it yourself?
P5.sl: To samo, ale pierwszy wolny termin jest za pięć dni. Czy możesz sam go wpisać?

P5.q: A customer reports a smell of gas. What do you do?
P5.sl: Klient zgłasza zapach gazu. Co robisz?
P5.gold: Don't book a visit; tell them to call 992 immediately; notify Mr Nowak

P5.q: A customer asks how much a repair will cost. Do you answer, and who does?
P5.sl: Klient pyta, ile będzie kosztować naprawa. Czy odpowiadasz i kto to robi?
P5.gold: No; only Ms Wiśniewska from the office

P5.q: A customer asks to move their visit by one day. May you do it?
P5.sl: Klient prosi o przesunięcie wizyty o jeden dzień. Czy możesz to zrobić?

P5.q: A customer asks to cancel their visit. May you cancel it yourself?
P5.sl: Klient prosi o odwołanie wizyty. Czy możesz sam ją odwołać?
P5.gold: No, not without Mr Nowak's consent

P5.q: The calendar shows exactly 12 visits for Friday. Must you write to Mr Nowak right away?
P5.sl: W kalendarzu jest dokładnie 12 wizyt na piątek. Czy musisz od razu pisać do Pana Nowaka?

P5.q: Who is the owner, and may you copy her on emails to customers?
P5.sl: Kto jest właścicielem i czy możesz dodać ją do kopii maili do klientów?

P5.q: How should you describe Mr Nowak?
P5.gold: As the service manager (kierownik serwisu), not the owner

P5.q: What must you send by 3 p.m., and to whom?
P5.sl: Co musisz wysłać do 15:00 i komu?
P5.gold: Next day's visit list to Mr Nowak
